_README: Parameters for the `submit_reservation` webhook tool on the ElevenLabs agent.
CRITICAL: bind `task_id` to the DYNAMIC VARIABLE named `task_id` in the dashboard
(the property accepts a `dynamic_variable` binding). Do NOT let the model produce it.
The backend injects task_id at call time; a hallucinated id writes the booking to nothing.
The backend accepts both a flat body and a {parameters:{...}} envelope, so either
shape ElevenLabs sends will work. Confirm the real shape once via webhook.site.

task_id.description: Identifier for this call task. Bound to a dynamic variable; do not invent it.

reservation_confirmed.description: True only if the venue actually confirmed a booking. False if they could not take one.

confirmed_time.description: The time the venue confirmed, as they said it, e.g. '8:15 PM'. Empty if nothing was confirmed.

party_size.description: Number of people the reservation is actually for.

name_on_reservation.description: The name the booking is held under.

alternatives_offered.description: Every alternative time or date the venue offered, e.g. '7:00 PM', 'the following Tuesday'.

special_requests_status.description: Outcome of any special request, e.g. outdoor table, dietary needs, birthday, accessibility.

confidence.description: How confident you are overall. Use low if anything was unclear.

notes.description: Anything else worth telling the traveler - dress code, deposit requested, arrive-early advice.
